capture_time_note: These are recorded session bounds; the exact raw-query request timestamp was not separately recorded.
source_capture_scope: Full selected-band/window population for the two endpoint callsigns, across all endpoint locations; no mode, geographic, peer, cycle or duplicate filtering
source_csv_conversion: Pandas read_parquet; stable sort time,id; ISO UTC timestamps; promote coordinate float32 columns to float64 before CSV serialization; preserve all source columns and rows.
expected_input_boundary: Only raw CSV and frozen configuration; no WSPRadar imports, frozen application outputs, overlay or paper landmark values are calculator inputs.

paper.license_verification: PDF repository cover says CC BY; printed page1 license text and annotation URI https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/.
paper.feature_copy_policy: Byte-for-byte unchanged source extraction; observations and tolerances communicated before archive comparison, feature artifact assembled afterwards.

correction_choice.basis: User-selected rounding of website value, graphically reconciled with Figure6; does not prove which correction generated the paper or establish a paper error.

review_artifacts.paper_figure6.png: Embedded published JPEG converted to RGB PNG.
review_artifacts.figure6_overlay_1p6.png: Observed A/B/C comparison: original full publication image at fixed tick calibration; actual WSPRadar reception-order reconstruction; production white Selected Station Evidence at 12h. Diagnostic, not a new external oracle.
review_artifacts.observed_landmark_comparison.csv: Observed comparison only; independent acceptance comes from unchanged paper_features.json.
review_artifacts.figure6_overlay_1p6.pdf: Vector-native counterpart to the PNG; original publication image remains raster.
review_artifacts.comparison_presentation.json: Presentation builder and observed landmarks; does not modify scientific expectations.
